items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer lists 'Tough Davey' among other musicians (Bix Beiderbecke, Benny Goodman, etc.) in the context of the Onyx Club scene, but the interviewee does not explicitly confirm a personal interaction or relationship with Tough Davey in the provided text.

ctx.x: En Mass, en masse, everybody would go. We would sit in with Louis and then we'd go across the street to the Onyx Club, Jimmy Noon, he was the clarinet player. He was one of our great jazz men. And then we'd all sit in up there with Jimmy Noon until three, four five o'clock in the morning we'd get out of there, six o'clock sometimes.
Bix Beiderbecke and (Trumbauer (Trombone?) and Benny Goodman Tough Davey (Tessmacher (Tessmacher)), all the guys. Bud Freeman
And that's where we, I guess that started the integration musically style xxxxxxxx you know.
